chapter: Playing in the country and Delacroix
title: Flag raising and pot go shooting at Razo
summary: Asked about flag raisings, Tom describes a shooting contest with a decoy on a post near Delacroix, which he did not play for.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
